_doc: Authored connector of the composite map (ARCH_OPTIONS SC1; P0-029 stitch bench draft). Control points are world metres (east +X, north -Z, origin at the centre of the layout C map box). The first and the last point lie on the boundary ports named in from and to. spans name the control points a bridge runs between. Not signed off.
name: Vikas Marg
standsFor: Vikas Marg and the ITO bridge over the Yamuna into East Delhi; its west end stands for Purana Quila Road and Mathura Road up to ITO

spans.over: the Yamuna (stand-in: the river band of layout C)

notes: At Laxmi Nagar the two carriageways of Vikas Marg cross the clip line 27 m apart along the road (the line is oblique there), so this end sits on the point between the two ports.
